headline: On last trading day, Sensex and Nifty ended higher led by IT and Pharma, with eyes on upcoming weekly trends.

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Monday, 2 November.

why: Nifty and Sensex rallied up to 2% last week, supported by IT, Pharma, and foreign inflows.
Buying in key heavyweights like Reliance Industries and Adani Ports boosted market sentiment in recent sessions.
Rising India VIX and crude oil prices above $116 added volatility during recent trading days.
Strong October auto sales metrics for major automakers provided stock-specific support.
whatHappening: Tata Motors reported a 27% increase in October auto sales, driven by strong domestic and export growth.
Eicher Motors' arm recorded a 35% jump in October sales on strong domestic business performance.
Adani Ports surged 4% during recent trading sessions as Sensex saw a 600-point jump.
Investors are focusing on market factors including US Fed policy, crude oil, and GIFT Nifty cues for the upcoming week.
summary: Indian markets remained closed on Sunday for the weekend following a strong performance in recent trading sessions where Sensex and Nifty gained up to 2% over the week. Gains were spearheaded by IT, Pharma, Reliance buying, and a surge in Adani Ports, alongside robust October sales reported by Tata Motors and Eicher Motors. Market participants are now preparing for the upcoming week starting November 2, tracking global cues and crude oil prices.
